title: Walker self-healing + plugin manifest regression test
definition_of_done: SKILL.md step 5 modified so that after spawning each child Session B the walker invokes the harness Monitor tool against the child's watch_command with persistent: true, timeout_ms: 3600000; walker's child-event dispatch table covers idle (with claw-drive status check + last_token branching for [DONE] / [NEEDS-INPUT] / 5xx-retry / continue-waiting), tool_decision_required, turn_completed [DONE] / turn_completed [NEEDS-INPUT], and session_stopped; transient-5xx regex 5\d\d\b|API Error: 5\d\d|temporarily unavailable triggers mcp__claw-drive__send_turn with the message 'API recovered. Retry the last operation.'; tests/skills.test.ts gains a regression test asserting that reference-impl/.claude-plugin/plugin.json has no skills property; tests/skills.test.ts also gains a regression case for the walker self-healing additions
acceptance_criteria: Walker no longer requires Session A nudges to react to children's [DONE] / [NEEDS-INPUT] / 5xx-error idle events
tests/skills.test.ts regression test asserts plugin.json has no skills key
vitest run on reference-impl reports 0 failures
